Relative seats, settled (supersedes the Latest and Final comments). Jack Heart (2026-11-12): "Maybe Final() would be better, sitting on top of Fixed(arm, clock)"; on the name, `Fixed` collides with fixed players (`Code`/chosen `Model`, `Matchup.fixed`), so no `Fixed`: the existing rules take an optional `job` (default: the held checkpoint's own learner line). `At(clock, value, job=None)`: a checkpoint at an exact position. `Final(job=None)`: `At` at that job's end position, a gap until it ends. `Earlier(clock, by, job=None)`, `Fraction(clock, value, job=None)`: relative to the held checkpoint's position. `Aligned(clock, job)`: another job at the held checkpoint's own position; "i think aligned is fine". Every relative seat resolves to the same checkpoint whenever held. Open for the demo: whether a failed job's Final is its last stored checkpoint (recommended, as manabot's frontier does) or stays a gap.
